Elevated three-quarter view, much closer than the reference, immersive large readable objects. No text, letters, numbers, UI, labels, watermark or people. Closeup of the reference camp's convoy bay: the same heavy dark armored six-wheel truck with vertical grille armor, forward plow spikes, amber roof lamps and cargo roof crates parked in a corrugated arched garage. Truck dominates the scene. Garage interior contains repair tools, workbenches, spare tires, oil drums and crates. Open front, warm light spills onto worn stone ground.
